fdfd458d1a.q: What is the new lifetime limit for Business Asset Disposal Relief from April 6, 2027?
fdfd458d1a.a: The lifetime limit for business asset disposal relief will fall from £1 million to £500,000 for qualifying disposals from the sixth of next year. Not so long ago, it was at 10 million. For a higher rate taxpayer with at least £1 million of qualifying gains and no previous business asset disposal relief claims, the change would mean an additional £30,000 in capital gains tax, assuming the excess is taxed at 24%.

b6b0dca9c6.q: What are the eligibility requirements for the new Founders Relief introduced in the 2026 Autumn Budget?
b6b0dca9c6.a: The eligibility requirements are demanding. They include significant ownership from the company's early trading period, a minimum five-year tax year holding period, substantial UK presence, at least £10 million turnover and 15 full-time equivalent employees, and qualifying combinations of rapid growth and research and development activity. HMRC estimates that only 600 individuals are going to qualify for this relief.

3c7edfe3ad.q: What is the capital gains tax rate available under the new Founders Relief for qualifying founders?
3c7edfe3ad.a: The new founders relief is a 10% capital gains tax rate on up to £10 million of lifetime gains. It applies to qualifying founders and early investors starting from April 6, 2027 for qualifying businesses preparing to transition to an employee trust.

fc2992c1e1.q: What were the outcomes of the Hedlund Group administration and asset sales?
fc2992c1e1.a: Administrators of the flooring distributor Hedlund Group completed transactions protecting 147 jobs. Domus Tiles, led by its existing management team, transferred all 112 employees. Melrose Interiors and certain assets were acquired by Jane Family Group, transferring another 35 employees. However, the Melrose Spectrum business unit was excluded, resulting in 19 redundancies. Buyers valued the established customer relationships, distribution capabilities, showrooms, experience team, recognized brands, and manufacturing expertise.
